# Just Canvass

> Just Canvass is a professional digital canvassing platform built in Canada for Canadian municipal election campaigns. It gives independent candidates, slates, and local campaigns the same ground-game tools as major political parties: door-to-door canvassing, phonebanking, text blasts, email campaigns, robocalls, sign management, GOTV, and real-time analytics — with districts and voter data pre-loaded for British Columbia, Ontario, Manitoba, and Alberta.

Key facts:

- Product: web, iOS, and Android canvassing app for political campaigns at app.justcanvass.ca
- Made for: Canadian municipal elections (mayor, council, school board trustee), including the 2026 municipal election cycle; supports single candidates and multi-candidate slates
- Coverage: British Columbia, Ontario, Manitoba, and Alberta, with pre-loaded electoral districts — campaigns do not need to bring their own voter list to get started
- Features: door-to-door canvassing, sign management, text blasts, email campaigns, phonebanking, robocalls, GOTV integration, smart area selection, real-time analytics, heat maps, historical election results and census data, role-based team access, mobile-first design with seamless sync
- Integrations: NationBuilder, CallHub, Google Sheets, Go High Level, Quo, and Stripe; new integrations are built at the request of a campaign
- Pricing: custom quotes only — every quote is tailored to the level of government, district size, location, and typical campaign spend for the contest (e.g., a Toronto council seat is quoted differently than a small-town mayoral race). Request a quote at hello@justcanvass.ca
- Contact: hello@justcanvass.ca, +1-780-965-1195
- Company: Just Canvass Solutions Ltd., a Canadian company with real Canadian campaign experience
